name: Question 13
problem:
What is the system of equations represented by

$$
[\begin{aligned}10 & 25 \\ 12 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}15 \\ -6\end{aligned}]?
$$
worked_solution:
The  $2\times 2$ matrix represents the coefficients of $x$ and $y,$ while the $2\times 1$ column vector on the right-hand side represents the constants of the equations. So, we get the following system of equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}10x+25y=15 \\ 12x+3y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying both equations in the system, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x+5y=3 \\ 4x+y=-2.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 13
?

What is the system of equations represented by [1025123][xy]=[15−6]?

a
{2x+5y=154x+y=−6
b
{10x+25y=−1512x+3y=6
c
{10x+5y=−1512x+3y=6
d
{2x+5y=34x+y=−2
e
{10x+25y=−1512x+6y=3
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The 2×2 matrix represents the coefficients of x and y, while the 2×1 column vector on the right-hand side represents the constants of the equations. So, we get the following system of equations:

{10x+25y=1512x+3y=−6

Simplifying both equations in the system, we get

{2x+5y=34x+y=−2.
